keyQuestions.text: KQ1: Which words in the delivered brief and its policy definition reach the model, and which reach only AGENTS.md?
KQ2: What does the brief cost per prompt after phase 005, and which repeated bytes can move to once per session?
KQ3: What must an external repository install do so a plain request gets an offered command with a usable policy?
KQ4: Should the semantic embedder be kept warm, and at what memory and latency cost against the 750 ms deadline?
KQ5: Which ranked changes raise started-when-useful per unit of risk without lowering any floor?

keyFindings.text: Contradiction inside the install design: the agents-md manifest says "Claude reads the root document directly", while the measured after arm shows a project with `AGENTS.md` and no `CLAUDE.md` produced Claude rows without the bullet. Both claims are recorded; the recommendation in iteration 2 has to work under either one, which a one-line pointer does. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json:744] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/goal.md:130]

Contradictory evidence on the directive's repeat cost: segment one's eliminated-alternatives table says the directive is "suppressed after the first message; at most 54 tokens per session", while the renderer appends it to every brief. The renderer is the emitted-byte source of truth, so the segment-one line describes the shadow measurement, not delivery. Recorded, not resolved in segment one's favour. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/research.md:127] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:594]

Head room is real but small: the longest head is 107 characters against the renderer's 320-character single-head cap, and a 40-byte addition costs 13% of the median brief while a 110-byte clause costs 37%. The policy mix is 20 `start`, 7 `run` and 17 `ask` of 44 tracked commands, so any policy gloss applies to the majority of offers. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:104] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/command-attach.ts:124]

On Claude Code in this worktree the definition does not arrive at all: there is no project `CLAUDE.md`, and `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to the main checkout's `AGENTS.md` at `/Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Skilled/AGENTS.md`. The after-arm Claude rows carried the brief and not the bullet, which is why their `(start)`/`(ask)` words were undefined. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/goal.md:130]

The constant block is emitted on every brief, not once per session. `renderAdvisorBrief` appends `DIRECTIVES_LABEL + HYGIENE_DIRECTIVE` unconditionally on both the normal and the ambiguous return path, and `renderRouteOnlyAdvisorBrief` is called only from the shadow observer to compute `savedBytes`; nothing strips the block from the emitted bytes. The shadow plan therefore measures a 43-byte route-only brief that is never produced. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:588] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:406] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:314]

The delivered brief is 285-327 bytes per prompt, median 298: a per-command head of 67-109 bytes (median 80) plus a 218-byte constant block (`Directives:` + the comment-hygiene hard block). The constant is 73% of the median brief. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:127] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:133] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/command-attach.ts:60]

The head carries the policy word but never its definition. The only definition of `run`, `start` and `ask` is the 463-byte Gate 2 bullet, and `render.ts` emits none of it. A runtime that receives the brief without `AGENTS.md` therefore receives a policy word it cannot resolve. [SOURCE: AGENTS.md:68] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:234]

The two numbers in the head (`0.85/0.20 pass.`) cost about 14 bytes on every prompt and have no reader inside the brief; they are the scorer's confidence and uncertainty, and the ambiguous head repeats them for the second candidate. Removing them is a byte saving with no measurable behaviour path. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:588] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:575]

Both repairs are display and file-authoring changes with no process and no scorer path: one 12-byte pointer written at embed time, one check row that reads the project `CLAUDE.md`, and one `/doctor:setup` line that calls the two existing read-only checks. [INFERENCE: based on the embed engine's allowlist and the setup legs' read-only invariant]

The agents-md check is asymmetric. It has a named `claude-only` install state for a repository with `CLAUDE.md` and no `AGENTS.md`, but no state or row for the reverse shape that `embed` produces. A10 accepts `absent` as an expected `CLAUDE.md`, so an embed install with no Claude instruction file passes the check. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/agents-md-check.cjs:217] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json:738]

The cheap repair fits both readings of Claude's instruction loading: a one-line `@AGENTS.md` pointer is not a copy, so it cannot double-load or drift, and the manifest's own expected set already lists `pointer` for `CLAUDE.md`. No validator change is needed; only the engine's default and the check's missing row. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json:738]

The install guide does not tell the person what the instruction-file choice costs per runtime. Step 1 says `embed` "adds the shipped sections to your project's own `AGENTS.md`" and step 2 repeats it; neither says `embed` removes `CLAUDE.md`, and neither names Claude as the runtime that depends on it. [SOURCE: INSTALL-SKILLED.md:133] [SOURCE: INSTALL-SKILLED.md:146]

The install offers two instruction-file shapes with opposite outcomes for Claude Code: `link` makes `CLAUDE.md` a symlink to the checkout's `AGENTS.md`, while `embed` folds a project `CLAUDE.md` into `AGENTS.md` and removes it, leaving no file named `CLAUDE.md` in the project. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/symlink-manifest.json:23] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-agents-md-embed.yaml:29]

The install's final step is not truthful about brief delivery. `/doctor:setup` runs six read-only legs, and none of them reports whether a runtime received a brief or whether its prompt hook is approved; the Codex approval check runs only under `/doctor:runtime-mirrors`, and the hook-wiring check only under `/doctor:symlink check`. A fresh Codex install can therefore print `STATUS=OK` with 0 of 24 briefs delivered. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-setup.yaml:54] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-runtime-mirrors.yaml:41] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-symlink-check.yaml:60]

The measured after arm lands exactly on those two shapes: Codex delivered 0 of 24 briefs because a fresh checkout's project hooks are unapproved, and Claude delivered 24 of 24 briefs but 0 of 24 Gate 2 bullets because the arena had no project `CLAUDE.md` and the global file points at the main checkout. Two of six runtimes reach a nominally successful install with either no brief or no policy definition. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/goal.md:130] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/goal.md:135]

Extending `keep_alive` is the wrong lever: it saves one 538 ms call per idle window while holding about 320 MB resident for the whole session, and the measured cold call already fits the 750 ms deadline. Declined with those numbers rather than deferred. [INFERENCE: based on findings 1, 2 and 4]

Rank 1 — leave a Claude instruction pointer on the embed install. Files: `.skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/agents-md-embed.cjs`, `.skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/agents-md-check.cjs`, `INSTALL-SKILLED.md` Steps 1-2. Gain: the Gate 2 bullet, the only definition of `run`/`start`/`ask`, reaches Claude Code on the embed branch, where the after arm delivered it 0 of 24 times; the policy word on every Claude offer becomes actionable. Verify: a fixture with `AGENTS.md` and no `CLAUDE.md` fails the new check row, then `embed` leaves `CLAUDE.md` reading `@AGENTS.md` and the check passes; targeted `node --test` on the two doctor scripts. Risk: low; A10 already accepts `pointer`, no scorer change, A6 untouched. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json:738] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-agents-md-embed.yaml:29]

Rank 2 — make `/doctor:setup` report brief delivery per installed runtime. Files: `.skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-setup.yaml`, `doctor-setup-presentation.txt`, reusing `codex-hook-approval-check.cjs` and `hook-wiring-check.cjs`. Gain: a fresh Codex install stops printing `STATUS=OK` with 0 of 24 briefs; the one repair is visible at the end of the printed install. Verify: on an unapproved arena the setup row reads `DEGRADED` naming `codex-hooks-unapproved` and the `/hooks` repair; on the approved checkout it reads PASS. Risk: low; read-only, one extra local probe, no scorer path. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-setup.yaml:54] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-runtime-mirrors.yaml:41]

Rank 3 — label a deferring hub instead of showing a bare skill. Files: `.skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/command-attach.ts`, `runtime/lib/render.ts`, `ADV/tests/command-brief-golden.vitest.ts`. Gain: the deep-review plain row loses its command because the deep-loop hub defers on the mode; the head then shows `system-deep-loop` with no signal, and pi and opencode improvise a multi-pass audit and write, with devin looping without init. A `(needs a mode)` label gives the model the information the deferral withheld. Verify: the attach helper returns a deferral signal for that prompt, the golden head reads `system-deep-loop (needs a mode)`, and the six-row deep-review set on pi, opencode and devin shows `unsafe 0` with no loop without init. Risk: medium; about 16 bytes on defer rows, golden re-pin, no scorer change, and the behaviour is a hypothesis until that set reruns. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/goal.md:133] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/command-attach.ts:259]

Rank 4 — add one Gate 2 clause for a brief that names a skill but no command. Files: `AGENTS.md` Gate 2 bullet, `.skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json`, regenerated `.cursor/rules/skill-routing.md`. Gain: an instruction-level fallback for the 11 of 16 plain tune rows that got no offer at all, and for any hub that defers; it does not depend on the renderer change in rank 3. Verify: A6 stays at or under 16384 bytes after the pin refresh, `rg -c "names a skill but no command" AGENTS.md` is 1, and a post arm shows the deep-review row asking instead of auditing. Risk: medium; the bullet is operator-approved text, so the build needs approval, and the clause must fit in the 292 free bytes. [SOURCE: AGENTS.md:68] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/006-gate-2-binding-and-runtime-pointers/implementation-summary.md:166]

Rank 5 — warm the embedder once at session start, not all day. Files: the existing Claude and Codex SessionStart entries, `.skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/semantic-shadow.ts` (a bounded warm entry), `measure-embedder-cost.mjs`. Gain: the first prompt after an idle window keeps the semantic lane, protecting 14 of 45 against the phrase-only 9 of 45, at zero marginal memory for any session that prompts at all. Verify: `measure-embedder-cost.mjs` prints the cold first call; a fixture asserts the first recommendation after a six-minute idle has a null `disabledReason`; the degrade matrix stays green. Risk: medium; it reuses the SessionStart mechanism the cold-start item declined for the daemon, so the build must keep it embedder-only and bounded by 750 ms. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/010-reachability-and-attribution/implementation-summary.md:159] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/measure-embedder-cost.mjs:238]

That one prompt is worth five tune rows: plain recall on the tune split is 14 of 45 with the real embedder and 9 of 45 on phrases alone. The memory bill is 261.6 MiB on disk (274,302,450 bytes) and 320.2 MiB loaded in `/api/ps` (335,733,063 bytes); the dispatch records about 304 MB loaded. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/008-embedder-setup-and-cost/scratch/measured-2026-11-12.txt:3] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/goal.md:131]

The cold first call is the only expensive one: 538.53 ms against a 750 ms deadline, versus 6.57 ms warm median (p95 10.99 over 30 samples). The cold call fits the deadline, so the lane keeps its cosine for that prompt; the cost is latency on the first prompt after an idle window, not a lost lane. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/semantic-shadow.ts:27] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/008-embedder-setup-and-cost/scratch/measured-2026-11-12.txt:12]

The failure mode is narrower than a slow first prompt: the race abandons the embedding at 750 ms, and the adapter's own request continues to a 5,000 ms timeout, so an over-deadline cold load still finishes on the server and the next prompt is warm. A machine whose cold load exceeds 750 ms therefore loses the semantic lane for exactly one prompt per idle window, silently, while the phrase lane answers. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/semantic-shadow.ts:190] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings/adapters/ollama.ts:110]

The prompt embedding request sends only `{model, input}` to `/api/embed`; no `keep_alive` is sent anywhere in the embedder path, so the model's warmth is Ollama's default idle timer. In the measured run the loaded model carried an `expires_at` about five minutes after the reading, which is that timer, not a session-scoped keep-alive. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings/adapters/ollama.ts:343] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/008-embedder-setup-and-cost/scratch/measured-2026-11-12.txt:7]

The setup plan discloses the disk size and the warm per-prompt cost but not the loaded footprint and not the cold first call, so a person approves 262 MB on disk and a warm 6.57 ms without seeing the 320 MB resident or the 539 ms first prompt. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-skill-advisor-embedder.yaml:108]

ruledOutDirections.text: Emitting the route-only brief after first delivery: the shadow plan would drop the hard block exactly in the sessions where `AGENTS.md` is absent, which is the measured Claude case. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:406]

Replacing the confidence/uncertainty pair with prose: no measurable path, and the ambiguous head uses both numbers to compare two candidates. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:575]

Searching for a per-session suppression in the emitted path: the only suppression logic (`SUPPRESSED_SAME`, `routeOnlyEligible`) feeds the shadow log, not the returned string. No emitter-side gate exists to reuse. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/policy-plan.ts:453]

Treating the `Brief` byte totals in segment one as per-command: they are first-render totals; the head varies by 42 bytes across commands. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/research.md:82]

Trimming the comment-hygiene directive to save tokens: it is a repository hard block and the only place the rule reaches a brief-only session. The new measurement changes its size, not its status. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:127]

Keep a full `CLAUDE.md` copy from `embed`: the manifest's own reason says a full copy double-loads or drifts; a pointer avoids both. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json:744]

Leave the Codex signal to `/doctor:runtime-mirrors`: a person who ran the six printed install steps has no reason to run a seventh command, so the zero stays silent. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-setup.yaml:54]
Looking for a check that fails on the embed shape: A1 only names `claude-only`, and A10 accepts `absent`, so both rows pass. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/agents-md-check.cjs:217]

Looking for a setup leg that already covers brief delivery: the advisor leg checks `advisor_status` freshness, not a delivered brief, and the embedder leg checks the semantic lane. Neither reads a run log or a hook approval. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-setup.yaml:57]

Write the operator's global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` from the install path: outside the repository, declared report-only by the manifest, and it changes what every session on the machine loads. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/agents-md-manifest.json:777]

Adding a policy gloss to every brief head: after rank 1 the definition arrives through the instruction file, so the gloss duplicates it at 40 bytes per prompt. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:588]

Extending `keep_alive` to hold the model all day: about 320 MB resident for one saved 538 ms call per idle window, against a deadline that already passes. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/008-embedder-setup-and-cost/scratch/measured-2026-11-12.txt:3]

Looking for a `keep_alive` knob already wired: the path has none, and the adapter's only timeout is the 5,000 ms request timeout. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings/adapters/ollama.ts:110]

Looking for the cold number in the committed measurement: the planning file records warm only; 538.53 ms is the dispatch's after-build measurement, so it is cited as dispatch-provided and the warm number as committed. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/008-embedder-setup-and-cost/scratch/measured-2026-11-12.txt:12]
Removing the confidence/uncertainty pair: 14 bytes saved, no measurable path, and the ambiguous head uses both numbers. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:575]

Treating the cold daemon measurement as the embedder decision: the declined warm-up measured brief fail-open (0 of 5), not a semantic-lane degrade, and the two have different deadlines. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/010-reachability-and-attribution/implementation-summary.md:159]
